note: #[route(path)] accepts the axum 0.7 notation: :name and *name segments are normalized at macro time to {name} / {*name} for both the registered router path and OpenAPI (previously axum 0.8 panicked at router build). Malformed paths (unbalanced or nested braces, empty {} or :, duplicate parameter names, a catch-all that is not the last segment) are compile errors spanned on the path literal
